Chapter 1 - Introduction to Telephony on the Macintosh

Telephone Manager Initialization Reference

This section describes the constants, data structures, and functions you can use to initialize and configure the Telephone Manager and its associated telephone tools. It also includes information about the functions you may need to use in order to access the special features offered by some telephone tools for which there are no specific Telephone Manager functions.
